restrictions: Exactly 64-byte unkeyed messages; counter0, length64, ROOT|CHUNK_START|CHUNK_END=11; exactly two prefix rounds.
N=2^128 independent uniform 512-bit messages, generated in batches of seven using seven guarded 32-bit fields at stride36.
At most 2^110 key confirmations; two whole target hashes independently verify every returned full collision.
Classical 256-bit word RAM; guarded arithmetic is charged in ordinary operations, not as uncharged compression calls.
Analytical total-work cap; no practical full-width collision or full-scale experiment is claimed.

heuristics.statement: For iid uniform 64-byte messages under the fixed two-round target, the 160-bit key K=(o0,o1,o2,o3,o4) has the triple-interference and key-match tail bounds derived in proof Sections 7-8, within a total additional failure allowance of 0.003.
heuristics.scope: The fixed BLAKE3-r2 complete-message map on iid uniform 64-byte inputs, N=2^128, five-word 160-bit key.
heuristics.extrapolation: Uniform-output model yields Pr[Finterference]<2^-32 and Pr[Fcap]<=2^-15; bounded 20-bit projection experiments are relevant finite support, not proof at 256 bits.
heuristics.limitations: Full-width key distributions and conditional key/digest dependence are not proved. A deviation beyond 0.003 would invalidate the success claim; no confidence probability is asserted.
